changelog:
- v0.6.2 LAUNCHER REWORK: menu rebuilt as one simple 2D scrollable list per wade's launcher law — STORY CHAPTERS (ch1→ch5) then EXPERIENCES (Mano Magica, Guitarra, Pinta, Espejo, Galeria, Tu Ofrenda finale last); every row titled 'Name — built by Muse'. Deleted: Journey/Experiences tabs, Continue-Journey hero, chapter key-art cards, mode toggle (defaults to immersive), time-of-day selector, menu papel banners\n- v0.6.2 PANEL FRAMING FIX: menu quad now 0.96×1.28m at 2.0m, yaw-aligned to the live HMD forward on every menu open (+0.75s re-settle), with 0.5s guards that push the panel out when <0.8m and recenter when >30° off-axis — kills the right-edge button clipping from wade's headset photo\n- v0.6.2 INPUT, BELT AND SUSPENDERS: new DirectUIInput fallback draws its own bright-yellow laser beams from raw tracker poses (independent of XRUIPointer), per-frame raycast + trigger/pinch rising-edge clicks; both paths funnel through one deduped click injector (120ms/8px). Primary lasers thickened (8mm) and brightened; gaze dwell now fires only when NO beam is drawn by either path\n- v0.6.2 DIAGNOSTICS (ship-blocker): on-screen plain-words input-state line (controllers/hands/gaze/panel distance/boot time), ⚠ NO INPUT SOURCE LIVE warning, and a Test connection button POSTing a ping to the relay (shows SUCCESS/FAILED)\n- v0.6.2 TELEMETRY FIX: relay URL compiled in as fallback constant (was empty until the async version.json fetch — prime suspect for zero reports ever arriving); remote manifest can still override\n- v0.6.2 BOOT: staged startup — frame 1 is panel+quad+LOADING label; MarigoldSky and menu backdrop build on chapter load, music WAVs lazy-load on first play, altar decor deferred\n- v0.6.2 PAUSE: simplified order — Continuar (Resume, green) / Controles (Controls, blue) / Reiniciar (Restart, orange) / Prev|Next nav row (NEW, same 11-item order, wraps) / SALIR AL INICIO (EXIT) red full-width bottom; title shows the current chapter/experience name; laser clicks in the pause menu actually work now (clicks were never injected into the viewport)
- v0.6.1 TELEMETRY: GameplayTelemetry autoload (permanent system) - batched gameplay events (chapter start/end with 0.1s durations, first input method, pause opens, error breadcrumbs) POSTed to the same crash-log relay; feeds the weekly quality digest
- v0.6.1 KEYART: original folk-style menu cards for Pinta Alebrijes, Galeria de Recuerdos and Tu Ofrenda (previously showed placeholder art)
- v0.6.0 FACES: every character now blinks, looks at you, and talks/sings with a moving jaw - MarigoldCharacterRig procedural face system (calavera dancers, baile leader, 4 alebrije guides, pet deer, street musicians)
- v0.6.0 THE BOW, FINISHED: ch1 dancer's pupils snap to you, 1.5s eye contact, wink, bow with jaw-open smile, crowd-gasp stinger, petal burst, photo moment
- v0.6.0 MIRROR: skeleton self-avatar moment with spirit-glass shimmer reflection + 4 face-paint variants (persisted)
- v0.6.0 CAMERA: diegetic folk-art camera tool, 12 collectible festival moments, Galeria de Recuerdos photo wall
- v0.6.0 TELEPORT: marigold-petal arc teleport pads with spirit-bridge arrival bloom
- v0.6.0 FLIGHT: scripted 16s glides over the candle-lit town replace fade-to-black chapter loads
- v0.6.0 PINTA: paint your own moth-jaguar alebrije - it comes alive and joins your spirit menagerie
- v0.6.0 PAPEL UI: menu + pause reskinned in papel-picado cut-paper, 3D altar decor around the menu
- v0.6.0 BANDAS: skeleton street musicians in ch3/ch5 react to you (wave, original phrases, beat-synced)
- v0.6.0 OFRENDA: collect 4 memory objects (foto, pan, marigold, pick) across chapters; Tu Ofrenda candle-lit finale room
- v0.6.0 MOMENTS: espejo wink on energy threshold, baile beat-drop gaze lock, guide greetings, deer pet bliss/startle, guitar lean-in
- v0.6.0 TECH: MarigoldVoice autoload (Voice bus + spectrum jaw driver), 4 haptics, 4 stingers, 6 headless CI gates green
- v0.5.0 NEW: Mano Magica - guided hand-tracking tour (pinch a bud until it blooms, grab/throw petals, sculpt clay, conduct bells, pet an alebrije)\n- v0.5.0 NEW: Gran Baile Espejo - three calavera dancers mirror your real body moves via body tracking (hands-only/auto-dance fallbacks)\n- v0.5.0 PAUSE: universal pause/exit overlay - Menu button/Esc/floating button in every chapter + experience (Resume/Restart/Controls/Quit), freezes gameplay, laser+pinch+gaze+mouse\n- v0.5.0 OFRENDA PROPS: full in-house Blender ofrenda set — pan de muerto hero loaves, tall/mid/short candles with flame VFX wired to FlameAnchors, painted calavera skulls, ornate photo frames, tileable marigold garland
- v0.5.0 OFRENDA VIVA: finishing ch1 triggers nightfall - photos ignite with chimes + names, 5 beat-synced calavera dancers, petal ceiling fall, dancer's bow, amber candlelight grade\n- v0.5.0 BEAT SYNC: El Gran Baile troupe + leader now hop/sway/spin on the 120 BPM beat\n- v0.5.0 WEATHER ANSWERS GAMEPLAY: rain ripples ch2 bridge water, wind gusts push Guitarra petals + ripple banners + dim ch5 finale in storms\n- v0.5.0 TRANSITIONS: petal-fall curtain between chapters; ambient butterflies + horizon spirits in every chapter + experience\n- v0.5.0 CONTROLLER SKINS: styled virtual controllers with per-experience accessories + Controls legend card (pause menu Controls page)\n- v0.5.0 TECH: Android targetSdk 34\n- v0.4.0 LIVING SKY: MarigoldSky dynamic atmosphere - full day/night cycle with graded sunrise/sunset, procedural sky shader (sun, stars, moon, drifting clouds), simulated realistic weather (clear/partly/overcast/rain/thunderstorm/fog/windy) with smooth cross-fades, GPU rain, lightning + procedural thunder, distance fog, windblown leaves. Time-of-day selector in menu (Dawn/Day/Sunset/Night/Auto, default golden sunset). Global wind system drives papel picado ripple, flower sway, lantern flicker, petals. Realistic physics pass: plaza/chapter props now tip, tumble and collide (Quest-perf capped). Guitarra Mexicana keeps gentle weather while you play.\n- v0.3.0 MENU FIX: launch menu rebuilt as a 2D panel - the old 3D-button menu could not be clicked on Quest 3 (no pointer, mouse-only input). Quest controller laser pointers (trigger = click, always visible) + hand-tracking pinch select + desktop mouse fallback. Chapter select for all 5 chapters, AR mode toggle, Check for Updates built in.
- v0.3.0 NEW: Guitarra Mexicana - rhythm-strum + free-play folk guitar game in a lantern-lit plaza (original waltz composition, nylon-string plucks, score/combo, pinch-orbs to choose mode)
- MARIGOLD v0.1.0: a 10-minute Dia de Muertos journey in 5 chapters
- The Ofrenda: hand-place marigolds, photos and candles; pinch to light each flame
- The Marigold Bridge: cross a glowing petal bridge over luminous water
- Plaza de los Alebrijes: meet glowing spirit-animal guides, feed them light orbs
- Papel Picado Canopy: wave hands to ripple giant cut-paper banners
- El Gran Baile: follow-the-leader hand dance finale with petal fireworks
- Bonus guitar corner: strum plucked strings with hand distance
- Immersive mode + AR living-room mode (passthrough, anchored ofrenda)
- Original procedural folk-inspired score, Check for Updates built in
- v0.2.0 VISUAL UPGRADE: real CC0 3D models replace primitives (Kenney) - carved stone arches, real marigold flowers, paper lanterns, skeleton dancers, fountain, ghosts
- Controller haptics: feel candle lighting, feeding guides, dance moves
- Vivid HDR-look rendering: ACES tone mapping, stronger bloom, atmospheric fog
